verdict.rationale: Motion's own booking templates for scenarios such as sales demos can include "reminders" (motion-docs-7, motion-docs-50), and its AI Meeting Notetaker "follows-up with action items" after meetings (motion-docs-21). That is a documented but thin, single-mention basis for pre-meeting reminders and post-meeting follow-up. missing for 10: confirmation that reminders reach invitees by email, any SMS reminder support, configurable multi-step sequences with timing offsets, explicit no-show reduction features or reporting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
